hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: EulerSwap implements a custom AMM curve backed by Euler Protocol vaults as a Uniswap v4 hook. In beforeSwap, it fully handles swaps by computing quotes via its custom curve, depositing input tokens into and withdrawing output tokens from Euler vaults, and returning BeforeSwapDelta overrides to bypass Uniswap's native concentrated liquidity.
